tools.name: moxie.search_docs
tools.description: Keyword and semantic search across the connected repository's generated docs, conventions, documentation gaps, AI-context notes, and indexed code. Read-only; no side effects. Returns ranked matches in Markdown grouped into Documentation and Code sections, each with a title, snippet, and source paths

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "moxie.get_documentation_patterns" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get Moxie Docs' summary of how THIS repository organizes and maintains documentation - where docs live relative to code and how they are kept current. Read-only…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "moxie.get_conventions" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
